violation_type.title: Animals at Center - Children Not Allowed to Play with Unfamiliar Animals (26 TAC §746.3905(c))
violation_type.short_title: Animals at Center - Children Not Allowed to Play with Unfamiliar Animals
violation_type.typical_finding: This standard was reviewed as part of an investigation and found deficient. It was determined during the investigation that children were interacting and playing with a monkey that was brought to the operation.

finding_variants.text: This standard was reviewed as part of an investigation and found deficient. It was determined during the investigation that children were interacting and playing with a monkey that was brought to the operation.
During a visit from the Botanical Garden, children at the operation were able to pet reptiles, snakes, and lizards.
